title: Garden Aisle in White
desc: A white-and-green garden aisle: curved ground beds and an overhead greenery canopy, set with white folding chairs.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The white-green blooms lining the curved beds and canopy.

items.role: White hydrangea massing through the ground beds and overhead canopy.
Light green hydrangea ball accents mixed into the white beds.
White roses filling the beds and the floor cluster corners.
White larkspur spikes rising from the beds (tall white lily spikes in the scene).
White lisianthus-style blooms softening the bed edges (form-match for white lisianthus).

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: The airy greens that fill the beds and trailing canopy.

items.role: Eucalyptus sprigs through the beds and overhead greens.
Fountain grass plumes adding airy movement at the edges.
Fine trailing grass tails hanging from the canopy (form-match trailing grass).
Asparagus fern adding feathery texture inside the mixes.
